args.rationale: Rotate from Aurora to Cobalt on momentum and news: A -0.06% last Q and loses largest customer breaks prior +1.78% momentum story; C +0.29% last Q after +3.17% with renewal + analyst target + regulator clears flagship, plus ultra-low 0.3% vol keeps OTM 3% call cheap. Keep proven principal-protected leveraged-call structure (0% chance below 100, suitable for retail) with 150x for headline 578 vs Aurora 501. Price 131.5 vs model 128.28 = 2.5% markup to restore volume after N5 7.3% markup sold only 21.
